name: visimark
description: The numbers in your Markdown, checked on every commit: every computed number carries the formula that produced it, and a machine can prove the two still agree.
author: Michał Niedźwiedzki <michal@epsi.pl>

scripts.build: bun build src/cli/main.ts src/index.ts --target node --outdir dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:playground: bun build src/playground/browser-entry.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile ../../docs/vendor/visimark-browser.js && bun build src/playground/app/main.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile ../../docs/vendor/visimark-playground.js && bun run build:site
scripts.build:site: for p in index tutorial ci preview; do bun build src/site/$p-page.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile ../../docs/vendor/visimark-site-$p.js || exit 1; done
scripts.prepublishOnly: cp ../../README.md README.md && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
